transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I just keep beating myself up lately. I've been feeling like I'm not really senior material at my job, and, I don't know, like I just fooled everyone into thinking I could handle a lot more than I actually can. It's just been really weighing on me.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?

Yeah, I have. Most days lately I've just had this... this heavy, low feeling. It's like I'm just moving through my day at work and then at home, but... I don't know, it's like the color is just turned down on everything. Just kind of empty, yeah.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
No, not really. I mean, I don't feel nervous or on edge or anything like that. It's mostly just... just that heavy, low feeling I was talking about. So, no, I wouldn't say I've been anxious.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I'd say so. I usually look forward to grilling on the weekend, or maybe doing a little fishing. I like putting on a record, too, just to unwind. But lately... I don't know, I just leave the grill covered or the records sitting there. I just don't really care to do any of it right now.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, low feeling?
Well, looking back... I'd say these low periods, and sometimes feeling kind of guilty, too... they've been hanging around off and on for about eleven months now.
Do you still enjoy the things you do, even if you're not motivated to do them?

Not really, no. Like I was saying about the grilling and the records... it's not just a matter of getting up to do it. Even if I were to force myself, the enjoyment just isn't there. That's why I just leave the stuff sitting there. I just really don't care about it either way right now.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?

Yeah, I guess I have. My appetite has just been off lately. I mostly just grab a few bites here and there, or I end up skipping supper altogether. Because of that, I've noticed my belt is a little looser than it used to be, even though I'm not actually trying to lose weight or anything.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide lately?
No, I haven't made any actual plans to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I mean, I do catch myself thinking sometimes that it might just be easier if I didn't wake up some morning.
How often do you feel this heavy, low feeling during the day?
Most days lately, honestly. It's just this heavy, low feeling that kind of sticks with me throughout the whole day. It's like... I'm just moving through work and home with the color turned down.
Have you been feeling like you're moving slower than usual lately?

No, not really. I mean, I feel tired and kinda weighed down, like I said, but I don't think I'm actually moving or talking any slower than normal. Nobody's pointed anything like that out to me, anyway.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt somewhat better, or has the heavy, low feeling been constant?
No, not really. It's... it's been pretty constant. I can't really think of any days in the last couple of weeks where I felt like it lifted. It's just been that same heavy feeling every day.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions lately?

No, I haven't really noticed any issues with that. I mean, my job takes a lot of focus, and I've been able to concentrate on my work just fine. Making decisions hasn't been a problem either. My head feels clear enough, it's just... yeah, just that low mood I mentioned.
Have you experienced any significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other important areas of functioning due to these feelings?

I mean, I'm still making it to work. My focus is okay, like I said, but I have been double-checking myself a bit more just to be safe. Outside of work, though... yeah, I guess it is affecting things. I've definitely pulled back from my friends and family. I just don't really trust my mood or my judgment lately, so it's been easier to just keep my distance from people.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about things you've done or haven't done?

Yeah, I have. Actually, that's a big part of why I decided to come in. I just keep beating myself up about work. I keep getting this feeling that I'm not really senior material, and... I don't know, I just feel like I've fooled everyone into thinking I can handle a lot more than I actually can. It's been weighing on me.
Have you felt restless or fidgety lately?
No, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed feeling restless or... fidgety, like you said. I mostly just feel kind of slowed down, honestly.
Have you experienced any psychotic symptoms, such as hearing voices or seeing things that aren't there, during these low periods?
No, nothing like that. I haven't heard any voices or seen anything that isn't there. It's just the mood stuff, mostly.
Have you had any periods where these feelings were so bad that you couldn't get out of bed?

No, not really. I mean, there are mornings where I really don't want to... where I just kind of want to stay under the covers and ignore everything. But I always manage to force myself up and log on for work. It's never gotten so bad that I actually couldn't get out of bed.
Would you say these low periods have been mild, moderate, or severe?

I guess I would say they're... probably mild. I mean, since I can still function and get my work done every day, it doesn't feel severe or anything. It's mostly just a drag to get through, so yeah, I'd go with mild.
Do you feel like you've lost interest or pleasure in almost all activities most of the time?

Yeah, I'd say so. Usually, I really look forward to the weekends—getting the grill going, maybe doing some fishing, or just putting on a record to relax. But lately, I just... I don't know, I just leave all that stuff sitting there. I just don't really care to do any of it right now.
How long have you been feeling this way without any significant improvement?
Well, looking back on it... I guess these low, guilty periods have been hanging around off and on for about eleven months now.
